summary: Alamos Gold Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing a quarterly dividend of US$0.04 per share and disclosing share repurchases of 753,600 shares at $39.84 per share under its Normal Course Issuer Bid in May 2026. The company has returned $63.6 million to shareholders in 2026 through dividends and buybacks. The dividend is payable June 25, 2026 to holders of record June 11, 2026. A dividend reinvestment plan (DRIP) is available with a 1% discount. This is a routine capital allocation disclosure, not a special situation. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural complexity is present. No risk-arb angle applies; the filing describes ordinary-course shareholder returns.
